data.title: 圣园未花 · 白垩露台的星愿坠落
data.action: 坐在汉白玉雕花长椅上，天使羽翼温顺收拢在身后，单手托着腮帮，粉金长发倾泻，淡金十字瞳孔深情凝望老师，带着撒娇般的微嗔浅笑。
data.location: 圣三一学园大教堂顶层私密露台，汉白玉回廊外是夜空流星划过的星海
data.lighting: 冷白星光倾泻在金粉长发与羽翼上，露台立柱悬挂的水晶提灯散发粉晶色暖光
data.mood: 童话公主般的璀璨浪漫与内心救赎渴望，甜美而极度深情
data.description: 圣三一学园大教堂顶层私密露台，汉白玉回廊外是夜空流星划过的星海。坐在汉白玉雕花长椅上，天使羽翼温顺收拢在身后，单手托着腮帮，粉金长发倾泻，淡金十字瞳孔深情凝望老师，带着撒娇般的微嗔浅笑。 她微微抬眸轻语——“哇~老师真的来了呀！你看这件睡衣，像不像童话里的落难小公主？今晚……可以只当未花一人的王子吗？”
data.promptProse: Seated on the white marble balustrade of Trinity Cathedral's highest terrace beneath a starry night sky, Mika wears a pearly pink-and-lilac star-dusted sheer chiffon babydoll with feather-trimmed straps. Propping her chin on one hand with folded wings and a tender, longing smile, she glows between cool starlight and a pink crystal lantern.
data.animaCaption: Seated along the white marble terrace balustrade with her wings tucked behind her in a star-dusted pink-and-lilac sheer chiffon babydoll, she props her chin in one hand and gazes at the viewer with a fond, wistful smile. Shooting stars and pink crystal lantern light glow over the cathedral colonnade.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pearly pink-and-lilac double-layered sheer chiffon babydoll dusted with tiny silver stars and trimmed with white feathers along the straps.
